decision: Restore previous inline completion presentation for the resolved GNOME backend before a separate Firefox repair and desktop isolation.
reason: The shared auxiliary publisher introduced in 1.0.91 changed GNOME Kitty, WeChat and other clients. The user requested a narrow rollback and explicitly accepted its documented Firefox limitation.
supersedes: GNOME presentation scope only of 2026-10-18-separate-legacy-ibus-hint-from-document-composition; non-GNOME auxiliary publication and Atomic V1 are unchanged.
user_authorization: Да возвращай и потом отдельно решай проблему с с известным ограничением Firefox и потом уже разделяй KDE и GNOME разводи их

consequences.implementation: Use the existing resolved LayoutBackend and existing publish_preedit_payload fallback in one function. No new presentation module, delivery route, owner, executor, timer or queue.
consequences.authority: Candidate selection, Tab verification, buffers, correction, ownership and Atomic V1 are unchanged. Display alone does not grant edit authority.
consequences.known_limitation: Firefox may save a hint-bearing composition and finalize it on blur despite an empty reset response. The approved recovery temporarily reintroduces that known client limitation for GNOME; this is not a Firefox safety fix.
consequences.tests: Bind auxiliary safety/failure regressions explicitly to KDE rather than environment-dependent auto selection. Add explicit GNOME inline publication coverage without claiming client blur conservation.
consequences.rollout: Remote-only guarded compilation, exact artifact hash, installed-engine backup, then restart Lay through the existing helper. Preserve remote KDE and active applications.
consequences.next: Repair the first failed Firefox transition separately, then isolate desktop-specific presentation code.

verification: Harness2 lay2 task 20261023T112703Z-6f2c6591 reviewed the unchanged production rollback proposal: static 6/10, eight calls, zero failures. Later source, installed-byte and client evidence belong in the presentation document.
not_tested: Changed-byte display, Tab, blur/focus conservation, stale auxiliary handover and native latency remain NOT_TESTED at decision time.
